corrections.reason: The printed text at the end of line 18 is 'እለ ፡' (which joins with line 19 'እስክንድሮስ' to form 'እለእስክንድሮስ', matching the Amharic translation in lines 20-21 'እለእስክንድሮስ').
The printed Fidel is clearly 'ስ' ('ስንበት'), matching the commentary in Col 2 L01 ('አንድም ፡ ስንበተ ፡ ይላል').
The printed glyph is 1st-order 'ከ' ('መልከ ፡ ክፉ', compound construct state matching line 18 'መልከ ፡ ክፉ' and line 19 'መልከ ፡ መልካም').
